key_idea: Add up all the dots, then see how many dots must fly away.
steps: We want 16 dots. 24 - 16 = 8, so 8 dots must fly away.
The beetle with 8 dots flies away.

choice_feedback.A: If the beetle with 3 dots flies away, 21 dots are left.
choice_feedback.B: If the beetle with 6 dots flies away, 18 dots are left.
choice_feedback.D: If the beetle with 5 dots flies away, 19 dots are left.
choice_feedback.E: With no beetle gone there are 24 dots, not 16.
